content: AppleScript Messages.app: every buddy/participant must be resolved to a specific 'service' (iMessage vs SMS) before sending -- 'buddy X of service Y' -- and a recipient not already in an existing conversation/buddy list frequently cannot be referenced at all. The common workaround pattern is try-iMessage-first, catch, fall back to explicit SMS service; there is no built-in silent auto-routing exposed to AppleScript the way the GUI does it, so send failures surface as buddy-not-found errors, not a clean iMessage/SMS status.
